win_rate_threshold.rationale: 0.2% cost-adjusted threshold for win-rate classification. Covers transaction cost (~0.15% in TW market) + slippage buffer. ForwardReturn must exceed this to count as a win.

sharpe_min_samples.rationale: Minimum 5 per-agent forward-return samples before SharpeLike is reported. Below this, statistical significance is poor and the value is shown as N/A on the frontend.
